Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated the film’s co-production countries (“Franco-German”) with the director’s nationality, incorrectly labeling Volker Schlöndorff as German-French. Schlöndorff is German, like Rudolf Jugert, so both directors are from the same country. This misinterpretation led to the incorrect conclusion.
